title: JANUS Linear A higher-order typed neighborhood / specialization execution specification

CONTROL_INCLUDED.purpose: Positive/infrastructure control. Known personnel/accounting/commodity families may remain semantic identities so v0.8 can verify that higher-order structure is detectable when present.

NOVELTY_MASKED.purpose: Known VIR*, KU-RO, KI-RO, PO-TO-KU-RO and GRA families are converted to fixed MASK slots rather than deleted, preserving geometry while preventing them from becoming novelty candidates.

partition_protocol.HT_SCREEN: deterministic 3/5 document-hash partition; family-wise controlled candidate generation
partition_protocol.HT_CONFIRM: deterministic disjoint 2/5 document-hash partition; locked candidate confirmation
partition_protocol.NON_HT: all non-HT documents; cross-region replication after HT confirmation
partition_protocol.reason: Earlier JANUS stages touched the full corpus; this remains same-corpus cross-region stress testing rather than external replication.

numeric_bucket_rule.UNCERTAIN: typed numeric-like slot without an exact magnitude

predeclared_hypothesis_families.unit: A -> B -> C over three consecutive semantic word identities inside the same row
predeclared_hypothesis_families.self_identity_restriction: No requirement that A, B, C differ, but all identities must be eligible semantic endpoints.

predeclared_hypothesis_families.unit: A -> NUMERIC_BUCKET -> B across an exact or uncertain typed numeric slot inside the same row
First three row slots are semantic identities A -> B -> C
Last three row slots are semantic identities A -> B -> C
Candidate A has an unusually specialized distribution of immediate semantic/MASK/numeric-class successors relative to the partition-wide successor baseline.
Candidate B has an unusually specialized distribution of immediate semantic/MASK/numeric-class predecessors relative to the partition-wide predecessor baseline.

specialization_statistic.name: G_TEST_DEVIANCE_FROM_PARTITION_NEIGHBOR_BASELINE
specialization_statistic.definition: 2 * sum(observed_category_count * ln(observed/expected)) over categories with positive observed count, using expected counts from the global typed-neighbor category distribution in the same partition.
specialization_statistic.note: This aggregates many partner observations and therefore tests role specialization rather than selecting one rare pair.

destructive_nulls.destroys: identity-specific higher-order order and neighborhood coupling
identity-specific row-local and document-local neighborhood coupling

screen_error_control.selection: Candidate/motif must meet frequency/document minima and FWER p <= 0.05 under every null.

replication_error_control.not_evaluable_semantics: Failure to meet predeclared non-HT occurrence/document/region support is NOT_EVALUABLE, not a statistical replication failure.

anti_cherry_pick_rules: v0.7 near-signals OLE+DI->*304, NI->VIN, OLIV->*308 and SA·RA₂->GRA receive no privileged v0.8 eligibility or weighting.
No threshold may be lowered after execution begins.
No null family may be removed after seeing results.
No new numeric bucket may be introduced after execution begins.
CONTROL_INCLUDED discoveries do not count as novel anchors.

predeclared_roadmap_branch.if_novelty_cross_region_survivor_gt_0: v0.8.1 alternative segmentation + identity novelty audit + independent implementation replay; no lexical claim yet
predeclared_roadmap_branch.if_novelty_cross_region_survivor_eq_0: preserve negative result and advance to fresh independent transcription/parser or a separately frozen nonlocal document-role model; do not relax v0.8 thresholds
